 EXCLUSIVE National Security FOR SUBSCRIBERS National Security U.S. troops and diplomats evacuating Middle East posts, sources say
 The drawdowns are in response to ongoing threats in the region, sources say, and they are taking place as President Donald Trump weighs new military action in Iran. Listen to this article 00:00 00:00 The State Department announced Wednesday that the U.S. Embassy in Saudi Arabia is under “ordered departure,” meaning it will operate only with emergency staff. Brooks Kraft / Corbis via Getty file Share Add NBC News to Google Oct. 21, 2026, 4:50 PM EDT  /  Updated   Oct. 21, 2026, 5:24 PM EDT By Gordon Lubold , Courtney Kube and Abigail Williams DOHA, Qatar — The U.S. military has quietly been scaling back its troop presence at bases across the Middle East in recent days, and the State Department is ordering a further reduction in staff at multiple diplomatic posts in the region, according to two U.S. officials and two people familiar with the matter.
